title: Why Doesn't the Space Station Fall? 🛰️
description: The International Space Station orbits high above us at extreme speeds, but how does it stay up without crashing down? Discover the physics secret in under a minute.

scenes.say: The International Space Station flies four hundred kilometers above Earth. So why doesn't Earth's gravity pull it down?

scenes.caption: It is all about speed
scenes.say: The secret is not zero gravity. It is the extreme speed the station moves at.

scenes.label: Massive station speed
scenes.say: The station travels at twenty-eight thousand kilometers per hour, circling Earth every ninety minutes.
At this speed, the station is constantly falling toward Earth, but Earth curves away beneath it, so it keeps orbiting without crashing.
Because of this blazing speed, astronauts watch the sun rise and set sixteen times every single day.

scenes.say: Subscribe to How It Works! Next time, we discover how telescopes see the deepest parts of the universe.
